title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 16 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Corinthians chapter 16 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 16 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Corinthians Chapter 16.

questions.question: What is the collection for in 1 Corinthians 16:1?
questions.explanation: The collection is for the saints as stated in 1 Corinthians 16:1.

questions.question: On which day of the week are the Corinthians instructed to lay by in store?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:2 specifies that the collection should be made on the first day of the week.

questions.question: What does Paul say shall happen when he comes to them in 1 Corinthians 16:3?
options: He will stay for a long time
He will send approved men to Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: He will send approved men to Jerusalem
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:3, Paul states he will send those approved by their letters to bring their liberality to Jerusalem.

questions.question: True or False: Paul intends to visit the Corinthians immediately after passing through Macedonia.
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:5, Paul mentions he will come when he passes through Macedonia, indicating a planned visit but not immediate.

questions.question: What may Paul do during the winter according to 1 Corinthians 16:6?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:6 states that Paul may abide and winter with them.

questions.question: True or False: Paul plans to stay at Ephesus until the Feast of Passover.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:8 indicates that Paul will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost, not Passover.

questions.question: When does Paul hope to tarry with the Corinthians if the Lord permits?
options: When he travels back to Macedonia
questions.explanation: Paul expresses his desire to tarry with them if the Lord permits after he is in Ephesus until Pentecost as stated in 1 Corinthians 16:7.

questions.question: Who is instructed to be with the Corinthians without fear?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:10 specifically mentions that Timotheus should be with them without fear.

questions.question: True or False: Paul encourages the Corinthians to greet one another with a holy kiss.
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:20, Paul instructs them to greet one another with a holy kiss.

questions.question: What does Paul ask the Corinthians to do for those who help in ministry?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:18 encourages acknowledging those who refresh their spirit.

questions.question: What does Paul say about Apollos in 1 Corinthians 16:12?
options: He is busy at this time
questions.correctAnswer: He is busy at this time
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:12 indicates that Apollos was not willing to come at that time but would come when convenient.

questions.question: True or False: Paul wrote the salutation of 1 Corinthians 16 with his own hand.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:21 states that the salutation is from Paul with his own hand, indicating his personal touch.

questions.question: What does Paul desire to accompany him on his journey if it is meet?
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:4, Paul states that if it is meet, they shall go with him.

questions.question: What does Paul wish for the Corinthians at the end of the chapter?
options: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.correctAnswer: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:23 expresses Paul's desire for the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ to be with them.

questions.question: What phrase does Paul use for those who do not love the Lord Jesus Christ?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:22 states that if any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, he is to be Anathema Maranatha.

medium.title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 16 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Corinthians Chapter 16 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What does Paul instruct the Corinthians to do on the first day of the week?
questions.explanation: Paul instructs the Corinthians to lay by him in store upon the first day of the week, as stated in 1 Corinthians 16:2, ensuring there are no gatherings when he arrives.

questions.question: According to 1 Corinthians 16:9, what is Paul experiencing as he opens a great door?
questions.explanation: Paul mentions that a great door and effectual is opened unto him, but there are many adversaries, as noted in 1 Corinthians 16:9.

questions.question: What should the Corinthians do if Timotheus comes to them?
questions.explanation: Paul instructs the Corinthians to conduct Timotheus forth in peace, as he works the work of the Lord, as stated in 1 Corinthians 16:11.

questions.question: What is the house of Stephanas known for?
options: Addicting themselves to the ministry of the saints
questions.correctAnswer: Addicting themselves to the ministry of the saints
questions.explanation: Paul notes that the house of Stephanas has addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints in 1 Corinthians 16:15.

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 16:14 instruct about how to conduct all things?
questions.explanation: Paul instructs the Corinthians to let all their things be done with charity, as mentioned in 1 Corinthians 16:14.

questions.question: What does Paul request regarding Apollos in 1 Corinthians 16:12?
options: To wait for a convenient time
questions.correctAnswer: To wait for a convenient time
questions.explanation: Paul greatly desired Apollos to come but acknowledges that he will come when he has a convenient time, as stated in 1 Corinthians 16:12.

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 16:13 encourage believers to do?
questions.explanation: Paul encourages believers to watch, stand fast in the faith, quit like men, and be strong, as found in 1 Corinthians 16:13.

questions.question: True or False: Paul plans to see the Corinthians immediately as he passes through Macedonia.
questions.explanation: Paul states in 1 Corinthians 16:5 that he will come unto them but not see them immediately, as he plans to pass through Macedonia first.

questions.question: How does Paul describe the relationship between his spirit and that of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus?
options: They have refreshed his spirit and theirs
questions.correctAnswer: They have refreshed his spirit and theirs
questions.explanation: Paul expresses that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have refreshed both his spirit and the Corinthians' spirit, according to 1 Corinthians 16:18.

questions.question: True or False: All the brethren greet the Corinthians and are encouraged to greet one another with a holy kiss.
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:20, Paul mentions that all the brethren greet the Corinthians and encourages them to greet one another with a holy kiss.

questions.question: What does Paul say about those who do not love the Lord Jesus Christ in 1 Corinthians 16:22?
options: They are to be Anathema Maranatha
questions.correctAnswer: They are to be Anathema Maranatha
questions.explanation: Paul warns that if any man does not love the Lord Jesus Christ, he is to be Anathema Maranatha, as stated in 1 Corinthians 16:22.

questions.question: What does 1 Corinthians 16:16 ask the Corinthians to do?
options: Submit to those who help and labor
questions.correctAnswer: Submit to those who help and labor
questions.explanation: Paul instructs the Corinthians to submit themselves to those who help and labor among them, as stated in 1 Corinthians 16:16.

questions.question: True or False: Paul wrote the salutation in 1 Corinthians 16:21 with someone else's hand.
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:21, Paul states that the salutation is from him, written with his own hand, which indicates he wrote it himself.

hard.title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 16 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Corinthians Chapter 16.

questions.question: Who does Paul mention as having supplied what was lacking on the part of the Corinthians?
questions.explanation: Paul is glad for the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus, stating they have supplied what was lacking on your part (1 Corinthians 16:17).

questions.question: What does Paul encourage the Corinthians to do for those who have refreshed his spirit?
questions.explanation: Paul says to acknowledge those who refresh the spirits of others, specifically referring to Stephanas and his companions (1 Corinthians 16:18).

questions.question: Which household does Paul mention in connection with greetings from the churches of Asia?
options: The household of Aquila and Priscilla
questions.correctAnswer: The household of Aquila and Priscilla
questions.explanation: Paul sends greetings from Aquila and Priscilla, who have a church in their house (1 Corinthians 16:19).

questions.question: What does Paul instruct the Corinthians to do when greeting each other?
questions.explanation: Paul instructs that all the brethren greet one another with a holy kiss (1 Corinthians 16:20).

questions.question: In which verse does Paul write the salutation with his own hand?
questions.explanation: Paul specifically mentions that the salutation is from him with his own hand in verse 21 (1 Corinthians 16:21).

questions.question: What does Paul say about anyone who does not love the Lord Jesus Christ?
questions.explanation: Paul declares that if anyone does not love the Lord, they will be Anathema Maranatha, indicating a curse or separation (1 Corinthians 16:22).

questions.question: What does Paul wish for the Corinthians at the end of the chapter?
options: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.correctAnswer: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: Paul concludes by wishing for the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ to be with them (1 Corinthians 16:23).

questions.question: In which verse does Paul express his love for the Corinthians?
questions.explanation: Paul expresses his love for the Corinthians at the end of the chapter in verse 24 (1 Corinthians 16:24).

questions.question: True or False: Paul planned to visit the Corinthians immediately.
questions.explanation: Paul indicates that he will not see them immediately but hopes to stay with them if the Lord permits (1 Corinthians 16:7).

questions.question: True or False: Paul wrote the salutation of the letter with someone else's hand.
questions.explanation: Paul specifically states that the salutation is from him with his own hand (1 Corinthians 16:21).

questions.question: Which Old Testament theme does the collection for the saints relate to?
questions.explanation: The concept of collecting for the saints parallels the idea of firstfruits, as referenced in other passages about giving to God’s work (1 Corinthians 16:1).

questions.question: What Greek term is used in 1 Corinthians 16:22 for 'Anathema'?
questions.explanation: The term 'Anathema' in Greek signifies being cursed or devoted to destruction (1 Corinthians 16:22).

questions.question: Which literary device does Paul use in 1 Corinthians 16:14 when he instructs the Corinthians?
questions.explanation: Paul uses parallelism in his instruction to ensure that all actions are done with charity (1 Corinthians 16:14).

theological.title: 1 Corinthians Chapter 16 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Corinthians Chapter 16 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the collection mentioned in 1 Corinthians 16?
options: For charity to the needy in Corinth
questions.explanation: The collection is specifically for the saints, as stated in 1 Corinthians 16:1, which emphasizes the need to support those in Jerusalem.

questions.question: On which day of the week does Paul instruct the Corinthians to lay by in store?
questions.explanation: According to 1 Corinthians 16:2, Paul instructs them to lay by in store upon the first day of the week.

questions.question: Who does Paul mention he will send to bring the collection to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:3, Paul states that he will send those whom the Corinthians approve by their letters to carry the collection.

questions.question: Which event does Paul mention he will wait for before leaving Ephesus?
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:8, Paul indicates that he will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost.

questions.question: What does Paul say about the door that is opened to him in Ephesus?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:9 describes a great and effectual door being opened to Paul, indicating significant opportunities for ministry.

questions.question: What does Paul urge the Corinthians to do in 1 Corinthians 16:13?
options: To watch and stand fast in the faith
questions.correctAnswer: To watch and stand fast in the faith
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:13, Paul encourages the Corinthians to be vigilant and steadfast in their faith.

questions.question: What attribute of God is highlighted by Paul’s instruction to do everything in love (charity)?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:14 emphasizes that all actions should be done with charity, reflecting God's attribute of love.

questions.question: What relationship did the house of Stephanas have to the ministry of the saints?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:15 notes that the house of Stephanas has addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints, showing their commitment.

questions.question: What does Paul say about Timotheus in 1 Corinthians 16:10?
options: He works the work of the Lord
He is not to be trusted
questions.correctAnswer: He works the work of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:10 states that Timotheus works the work of the Lord, affirming his role in ministry.

questions.question: What does Paul ask the Corinthians to do for Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus?
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:18, Paul asks that the Corinthians acknowledge those who have refreshed his spirit and theirs.

questions.question: What does Paul declare about anyone who does not love the Lord Jesus Christ?
options: They will have a good reputation
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:22 states that anyone who does not love the Lord Jesus Christ is to be Anathema Maranatha, indicating a strong condemnation.

questions.question: What does the conclusion of 1 Corinthians 16 reveal about Paul's feelings towards the Corinthians?
questions.explanation: In 1 Corinthians 16:24, Paul expresses his love for the Corinthians, emphasizing the importance of love in Christian community.

questions.question: How does 1 Corinthians 16 connect to the broader narrative of Scripture regarding the support for the church?
options: It shows a lack of support
It highlights communal support and generosity
It ignores the needs of others
questions.correctAnswer: It highlights communal support and generosity
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16 exemplifies the early church's practice of supporting one another, reflecting the biblical principle of community and generosity found throughout Scripture.

questions.question: What combined teaching do verses 6 and 11 convey about Christian relationships?
options: Christian relationships should be based on fear
Support and peace should characterize Christian interactions
questions.correctAnswer: Support and peace should characterize Christian interactions
questions.explanation: Verses 6 and 11 together emphasize the importance of support and peace in Christian relationships, highlighting a community built on love and mutual encouragement.

questions.question: What combined insight do verses 2 and 14 teach about Christian giving?
options: Giving should be planned and done in love
Giving is only for the rich
questions.correctAnswer: Giving should be planned and done in love
questions.explanation: In verses 2 and 14, Paul instructs the Corinthians to plan their giving and to do it with charity, emphasizing intentionality and love in their contributions.
